widths.boundary_rule: Author describes the main offshore flow band between 15 and 35 km from coast off Menton–Nice. Span is about 20 km; boundary velocity threshold unspecified. Inshore highly variable flow is not silently included.
widths.extraction_method: Source-reported offshore band positions transcribed; subtract 35 minus 15 km for approximately 20 km local band span. No curve digitized, velocity threshold fitted or map footprint constructed.
widths.geographic_scope: Local Menton–Nice Northern Current profile, assigned to the Ligurian regional segment under the OSW ledger convention. Not representative of the whole segment or broader Northern Current.
widths.layer: Surface-flow geography in a study combining CODE drifters following the first metre and ARGOSPHERE drifters following the first 10–20 cm with unquantified wind slip. No full-depth or shelf-break axis diagnosed from the editorial route.
widths.name: Ligurian Current
widths.range_interpretation: Difference between source-reported 15 and 35 km coast-distance limits; those are positions, not a 15–35 km width range, statistical uncertainty or seasonal margin.
remaining_gates: Resolve local physical boundaries and wind slip before an occupied footprint or depth-wide width.
Obtain compatible repeated seasonal observations before annual dimension ranges.
widths.section_orientation: Source cross-shore coast-distance coordinate in local along-shore velocity profiles; exact flow-normal section geometry unresolved.
widths.source_citation: Poulain, Gerin, Rixen, Zanasca, Teixeira, Griffa, Molcard, de Marte and Pinardi (2012), Aspects of the surface circulation in the Liguro-Provencal basin and Gulf of Lion as observed by satellite-tracked drifters (2007–2009), Bollettino di Geofisica Teorica ed Applicata 53(2), 261–279, doi:10.4430/bgta0052.
widths.source_locator: Section 4, pp. 273–274, Fig. 9b and Discussion p. 276: local flow between 15 and 35 km from coast; section 2.1 distinguishes surface drifter types.
widths.time_convention: Intermittent coastal drifter profile composite: June–October 2007 and October–November 2008 source context. No exact local-band sampling dates, continuous observation period or seasonal climatology.
